data.creator_notes:
Starts with 0%, game over at 100%.

Works well on GPT4, should work decently on other model too, the instructions aren't complicated.

The brand's percentage increase by 1% everytime you send a message, so you only have 100 message to save yourself (That is, if you want to). You can tweak the parameter as you liked, like making it only increase 0.5% each message instead.

It should be possible to find the cure, but I did not put the instruction about it in the card or lorebook. Which means it's open-ended and the solution could be different on each chat.

Download V2. GPT4 follow description just fine, but if your model refuses to read it, use lorebook to force the model into changing your state based on %. To Anon: if your model doesn't recognize instruction, it could be too weak or is not suited to RPG-like instructions. You can add the last part of the desc or manually write ``` and hit continue, it should be 'used' writing it after a few messages.
